topic: Create and validate cron schedules for recurring jobs

defects.detail: The description 'Helps with scheduling things.' is generic and unspecific, providing no concrete details about what the skill covers or when to use it.

defects.location: SKILL.md frontmatter line 1 vs. directory name
defects.detail: The frontmatter name is 'cron-schedule' but the directory is 'cron-scheduler', creating a mismatch between the skill name and its location.

The skill mixes 'job', 'task', and 'entry' to refer to the same concept (a scheduled unit of work): 'run recurring jobs' (description), 'Setting Up a Cron Task' (heading), 'typical cron job' (body), 'scheduled entry ran' (body), 'the entry has write permissions' (body), 'Not testing the job command' (body), 'Test the entry command' (body), 'backup task is scheduled' (checklist).
